Container.Name: HomeboxLabel
Container.Overview: External label service for Homebox that generates 4 x 6 inch location labels while preserving compact item labels and QR-code links back to Homebox.
Container.ExtraSearchTerms: homebox label labels dymo qr inventory location item
Container.Requires: A running Homebox instance with External Label Service support.

Config.Name: Service Port
Config.Description: HTTP port Homebox uses to access HomeboxLabel.

Config.Name: Homebox Public Base URL
Config.Description: Public base URL of your Homebox instance, for example https://homebox.example.com. Used to convert relative Homebox paths into complete QR-code URLs.
